title: Rugby Union Tightens Concussion Protocols
summary: Players face longer mandatory rest after head knocks.

body.text: Early reactions from the community have been broadly positive, though some raised questions about timing.
Further details are expected at a briefing scheduled for later this month.
If it is not measured, it will not improve.
Officials stressed that the plan will be rolled out gradually to avoid disruption.
Long term, the impact will depend on adoption by the wider industry.

author.name: Jonas Weber
author.bio: Senior sports writer and former athlete.
